description: Converts HTML you already hold to Markdown. Nothing is fetched.

html.description: The HTML to convert, up to 2 MB.

images.description: When false, drops images from the output.

links.description: When false, replaces links with their text.

max_chars.description: Longest Markdown to return, in characters, from 1000 to 500000. Sent as 20000 when omitted.

mode.description: `article` (default) keeps the main content. `full` converts the whole body.

name: convert_html_to_markdown
title: Convert HTML to Markdown
